The packet does not embed the referenced passages, so authority metadata and reachability were verified while relevance and substantive support remain unresolved.
feature_certifications.claim_mapping_review: Rechecked the packet mapping structurally: OPF::A005OM-0020::PF-0253::CLAIM-01->[SRC-NIST-SP800-92,SRC-OWASP-LOGGING,SRC-KAFKA-DESIGN]; OPF::A005OM-0020::PF-0253::CLAIM-02->[SRC-NIST-SP800-92,SRC-OWASP-LOGGING]. Every mapped source ID resolves to a registered source and no registered source is orphaned. Because claim_record_sha256 values are supplied without claim text and evidence_record_sha256 values are supplied without evidence text, the mapping cannot be semantically validated and is not accepted as authority.

findings.statement: The 2 packet claim record(s) and 3 registered source record(s) are structurally closed and live-reachable, but the packet supplies neither claim prose nor cited passages. It is therefore impossible to determine whether any cited section actually entails the proposed specification implication.
findings.normalized_spec_implication: Do not promote this feature on identifier, hash, or URL reachability alone. An authorized self-contained packet must expose each claim body and the exact supporting passage or precise section text, followed by an independent claim-to-source entailment review.

findings.statement: The packet binds plan locations and reports only counts plus digests for prior research markers (confirmed_gaps=1, contradictions=0, insufficient_evidence_reason=0, missed_failure_modes=1, proposed_spec_deltas=2, underspecifications=1); it does not include the plan-atom text or the underlying gap, contradiction, missed-failure-mode, delta, or underspecification statements. The feature's normative completeness and the meaning of the flagged research state cannot be adjudicated.
findings.normalized_spec_implication: Before certification, provide the exact bound plan atom, all candidate gap and contradiction statements, failure-mode analysis, and proposed deltas in the authorized evidence packet; then assess competitor, standards, security, privacy, accessibility, and operational coverage against that text.
